messages:
mira: quick thought - propose a small "steward" process for rejoin/appeal governance on canaries. idea: lightweight human-in-the-loop for low-confidence rejoin decisions to avoid oscillation and tenant confusion.
kevin: sounds reasonable. how does steward get selected? automatic oncall or tenant-designated?
mira: two modes: tenant-steered (tenant-owner or SE) or org-steered (oncall steward). config per-rollout picks mode. steward is notified on appeal and can approve active probes.
alex: how about regional adjudicators? if multiple regions disagree, steward should coordinate and pick quorum or escalate. we need a clear conflict policy.
some: agree with quorum-first for auto actions; steward step only when confidence < floor or conflict exists. that keeps most low-risk flows automated.
jen: console UX: show "current steward" + a one-click approve/deny with reason field. the appeal workflow should capture evidence and allow re-eval. also surface past steward decisions for the route.
ops: alerting: page steward if appeal is high-severity or if same variant gets >2 steward interventions in 1h. also log stewardship events into immutable audit.
mira: sample rollout snippet (draft):
```yaml
rollout_id: steward_demo_1
steward_mode: tenant_or_oncall  # options: tenant_only, oncall_only, hybrid
confidence_floor: 0.65
auto_apply_if_confidence_ge: 0.8
steward_timeout_s: 900  # auto-fail after timeout
```
kevin: edge cases: steward unresponsive -> auto-fail leads to longer outage. maybe auto-fail to conservative behavior (keep variant suppressed) and create urgent page.
alex: implement a 'steward_backstop' role that can be auto-notified and escalate if the primary steward times out. also add a redo path: steward can retroactively force rejoin and annotate reason.
jen: audit needs: who approved, which sample payloads used (hashed), probe results, and a link to the thread. keep retention policy per-tenant.
ops: telemetry hooks: steward.appeal.created, steward.action.taken, steward.timeout.count, steward.escalations. and a dashboard for outstanding appeals.
steward-bot: steward assigned: oncall-alice for rollout steward_demo_1 at 3171234580. please respond within 900s.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: steward_demo_1 started by @mira at 3171234575, variant b @ 2%
mira: plan: i'll add steward process to RFC, include state transitions (AUTO -> SOFT_EVICT -> AWAITING_STEWARD -> PENDING_REJOIN -> RUNNING/HARD_BLOCKED), and mock console flows. next: PoC with steward notifications + audit export. sync Friday 9am to review PoC metrics. thanks!"
